# smyx-rehab-motivation-encouragement-analysis v1.0.3 Changelog

- Updated skill documentation (SKILL.md) with a restructured overview, clearer workflow, and improved usage instructions, especially around user identity handling.
- Revised user authentication flow: now handles open-id/user identity internally and no longer requires prompting the end user for identification.
- Strengthened cloud-only historical report queries; local history and manual summary are strictly disabled.
- Refactored scripts and config to support internal-only identity logic, automatic association, and new system defaults.
- Removed redundant or outdated files (scripts/api_service.py, skill-card.md).

- Improved configuration management: now checks both skill-specific and shared config files for API key (open-id).
- Refined open-id retrieval logic; execution strictly enforced to require valid open-id before any analysis.
- Enhanced documentation and user instructions for setup and operation.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md for better maintainability.
- Minor updates for consistency across script and utility files.

smyx-rehab-motivation-encouragement-analysis v1.0.0

- Initial release of an AI-powered skill for detecting frustration and giving-up tendencies in rehab patients via fixed camera video (and optional audio) analysis.
- Identifies behaviors such as sighing, training interruption, head-down silence, sluggish/perfunctory movements, and long-term lack of progress.
- Triggers a four-level personalized motivational intervention: gentle audio encouragement, progress-comparison display, therapist app notifications, and urgent push for therapist/family intervention if severe.
- Provides real-time monitoring and prompt positive reinforcement to reduce rehab discontinuation and support adherence.
- Includes robust privacy/authorization and open-id control, with strict cloud-based historical report retrieval protocols.
